matter.title: Engagement Letter (sell-side M&A advisory) — Calder & Rowe ↔ Ashton / Pembroke Ridge
party_lines: Calder & Rowe Securities LLC — exclusive sell-side financial advisor
Ashton Medical Devices, Inc. & Pembroke Ridge Capital, L.P. — client
matter.doc_type: Engagement letter · sell-side M&A advisory · Complex

source.text: 9. INDEMNIFICATION. The Client shall indemnify the Advisor for any and all losses arising from the engagement.

legal_issues.says: Client indemnifies the advisor incl. losses partly caused by the advisor; carve-out only for loss found solely from intentional misconduct.
legal_issues.risk: Client bears the advisor's own negligence; the standard is far off-market.
legal_issues.recommendation: Carve out advisor negligence/GN/WM/bad faith/fraud; delete 'solely'.
legal_issues.fallback: At minimum GN/WM/bad faith/fraud, and drop 'solely'.

legal_issues.says: 1.9% fee (min $3.5m) earned on an IOI/LOI and due even if the deal fails to close.
legal_issues.risk: Multimillion-dollar fee with no completed deal and no proceeds.
legal_issues.recommendation: Fee earned only on closing; not due if the deal fails.
legal_issues.fallback: Tie to a definitive agreement that later closes.

legal_issues.says: Advisor's liability capped at retainers paid while the client's indemnity is uncapped.
legal_issues.risk: Grossly asymmetric; the cap also swallows advisor fraud/WM.
legal_issues.recommendation: Reset the symmetry and carve fraud/WM/GN out of any cap.
legal_issues.fallback: A cap at fees paid only if the indemnity is correspondingly limited.

legal_issues.says: 30-month tail on any transaction; no covered-party list, no breach exception.
legal_issues.risk: Fee survives on deals the advisor never touched.
legal_issues.recommendation: Shorten to 12 months, limit to a named covered-party list, disapply on advisor breach.
legal_issues.fallback: Up to 18 months if firmly limited to a named list.

legal_issues.says: All advisor & affiliate expenses reimbursed — uncapped, no approval, no receipts.
legal_issues.risk: Open-ended, unverifiable spend on the client's account.
legal_issues.recommendation: Require receipts and prior approval over a threshold; exclude internal allocations.

business_terms.term: Success fee — 1.9% of Aggregate Consideration, $3.5m minimum (§2)
business_terms.confirm: Is the rate, minimum and base approved?
Comfortable being tied to the advisor across the sponsor family?

business_terms.term: Sponsor guarantee & public use of names/logos (§6/§7)

key_terms.provision: Earned on IOI/LOI/definitive/closing; due even if the deal fails
No Client Group member may pursue a Transaction without the advisor
All advisor & affiliate expenses, uncapped, no approval
30 months; no covered-party list or breach exception
Client indemnifies advisor incl. its own fault; advisor cap at retainers
New York; exclusive NY County courts; jury-trial waiver

edits.anchor: for any and all losses arising from the engagement
edits.before: for any and all losses arising from the engagement
edits.after: for any and all losses arising from the engagement, except to the extent arising from the Advisor's gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud
edits.rationale: Carve advisor fault out of the client indemnity.

client_email.subject: Ashton / Pembroke Ridge — Calder & Rowe engagement letter: decisions needed
client_email.body_markdown:
Hi team,

We've run a first-pass review and drafted a markup. A few commercial points need your call: success fee (§2), retainers (§2), exclusivity (§1/§3), term (§5), and the sponsor guarantee/publicity (§6/§7). On the legal side we're handling the indemnity and cap (§6), the fee trigger (§2), the tail (§5) and expenses (§4).

Best,
[Name / title]
